title: PicPay puts account enquiries inside Claude
evidence: PicPay is rolling out Claude for customers to check balances, bills, investments, cards and transactions. The bank had already moved first-level customer service to AI and generated more than 50 billion personalised recommendations last year.
scoring_reason: A real bank is using AI in customer-service and account-information workflows, changing service access and operating efficiency.

title: Lenders run AI agents inside regulated servicing work
evidence: Banks and specialist lenders run Salient AI agents inside loan-servicing, compliance and recovery workflows, where consistent scripts and auditable decisions can reduce regulatory and operating risk.
scoring_reason: Actual AI use changes regulated lending operations, compliance evidence and call-centre consistency.

title: PlusAI operates autonomous freight routes in Texas
evidence: PlusAI is operating AI-driven autonomous freight routes with Ryder and International Motors in Texas. Its HyperFoundry software has generated US$25 million in revenue and the company targets US$40–50 million in contracted 2026 revenue.
scoring_reason: AI is being used in live freight operations, producing operating data, utilisation gains and commercial revenue.

title: OpenAI exits a billion-dollar Cursor relationship
evidence: SpaceX’s acquisition of Cursor prompted OpenAI to end a model-supply relationship worth more than US$1 billion in annualised revenue. The change exposes continuity and concentration risk for businesses building workflows on external AI models.
scoring_reason: A real AI-supplier change has direct consequences for software continuity, procurement concentration and contingency planning.

title: AI data-centre investment reaches an extraordinary scale
evidence: US hyperscalers are expected to deploy roughly US$700 billion in 2026. A cited 2021–2024 state panel found no statistically significant residential electricity-price effect, but the backward-looking evidence does not guarantee future cost outcomes.
scoring_reason: The AI infrastructure cycle directly changes capital allocation, power procurement and cost-risk decisions for business leaders.

title: Council AI supports faster planning decisions
evidence: Wingecarribee Shire Council uses the DAISY AI planning-enquiry tool to support development-application work. In July, 89% of applications were determined within the expected timeframe, 20 percentage points above the NSW average of 69%.
scoring_reason: A council is using AI in a real planning workflow with measured service-speed results.

title: AI speeds software shortlists while sellers stay slow
evidence: More than 80% of business software buyers used AI chatbots for recommendations. 80% of AI users bought from their initial shortlist in at least three of five purchases, compared with 65% of buyers who did not use AI recommendations.
scoring_reason: Companies are using AI in the buying process, changing shortlist speed, sales friction and self-service expectations.

title: Enterprises expand AI across customer-experience work
evidence: Sprinklr reported more than 200 customer AI engagements and more than 180 billion customer conversations processed annually. Enterprises are using the AI platform across customer care, contact-centre and insight workflows to improve productivity and customer experience.
scoring_reason: Actual enterprise AI adoption changes customer-service workflows, productivity and implementation requirements.

title: Asana seeds AI use and absorbs near-term pricing pressure
evidence: Asana expects a US$1.2 million revenue headwind and 150-basis-point margin pressure while customers adopt consumption-based AI. AI products generated about 25% of net new annual recurring revenue in the quarter.
scoring_reason: Customers are using AI in work-management processes, changing adoption, pricing, revenue recognition and margin decisions.

title: NVIDIA agrees to buy the platform behind enterprise model choice
evidence: NVIDIA agreed to acquire Hugging Face for US$12.9303 billion. More than 200,000 companies use the platform to discover, evaluate, customise and deploy AI, making continued openness and supplier choice direct business concerns.
scoring_reason: A major AI-platform acquisition changes procurement confidence, model choice and deployment options for business users.
